WITH ordered AS (
  SELECT timestamp AS time, metric_value,
    LAG(metric_value) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp) AS prev_value,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (timestamp - LAG(timestamp) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp))) AS dt
  FROM snmp_metrics
  WHERE device_name = 'udm-pro' AND metric_name = 'if_in_octets.4'
    AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
)
SELECT time, 
  CASE WHEN dt > 0 AND metric_value >= prev_value 
    THEN ROUND((metric_value - prev_value) / dt)
    ELSE 0 END AS "WAN In (B/s)"
FROM ordered
WHERE prev_value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY time
